title: I just generated 234 cards at the push of a button.
author: M69_grampa_guy
selftext: I'm going to get plenty of hate in here but me and my AI buddy just spent a couple of weeks developing an SVG card mastering technique that set me up to produce cards at the touch of a button. I don't know coding.  I'm not using AI art. I'm just talking to chatgpt and learning along the way.  Develop one SVG master, put your card data on a spreadsheet and develop a card generation python script. It's magic!

comments.author: Saint_Reficul
comments.body: What is SVG card mastering? Bro you post has like no details or anything we can go off of.

replies.author: M69_grampa_guy
replies.body:
Sorry. It's a process I arrived at in conversation with AI. I just started expressing that. I wished I could do one thing or another to help manufacture my cards and the AI kept suggesting solutions. AIS are helpful in that way. 

This is what I have accomplished - All through conversation with AI.  Without using a vector graphics editor, although with a little LibreOffice draw, I developed an SVG multi-layered card document. All the elements of the card are empty so that they can be filled with a variety of colors and text formatting.  The genius part is the python card generator script that takes data from my CSV spreadsheet and dumps it into the SVG card Master. The AI helped me set it up with a Windows style button interface. Press a button and manufacture a whole deck of cards. 

All of this was accomplished through AI conversation over the course of weeks. I sort of wandered into it but it has become a secondary hobby along with my board game design. It isn't necessarily easy. AI can be temperamental and unreliable but if you keep at it and keep adjusting your prompts, you can make it do amazing things.

comments.author: CalmEntry4855
comments.body:
This sounds like the less hateable thing ever, although you are still getting some.

I'm guessing what you are doing is like this:  
You are not using AI for the art, which is what people hate.  
You are just using AI for the code to generate cards with different texts over the art that you provide, the only ones that would get angry at that would be traditional coders that don't like vibe coding, but even they wouldn't mind it in a project like this from someone that isn't a coder.

You are just automatizing things, which is very smart and satisfying, congrats!
